services.name: Giant Paddleboard the Springs!
services.desc: Explore the natural spring fed river downtown on a Giant Paddleboard! Duration 2 hours About The best way to experience the real Austin is to jump on a Giant Paddleboard with us and explore the natural spring fed river downtown. We start on Lady Bird Lake and quickly transition to the crystal clear waters of the famous Barton Springs Pool. Wear your swimsuit so you can jump in and swim around! It's so refreshing on a hot summer day. Expect to see 1,000 turtles and a lot of fish below! This trip is great for groups and families.
